In addition to manufacturing commercial printing and New Year's card printing through an integrated system at its own plants, it manufactures sign products, produces Web and digital content, plans SP (sales promotion) campaigns, and provides BPO, internet connection services, and the planning, printing and publishing of free papers. The consolidated subsidiary Print House Co., Ltd. engages in on-demand printing, and Aji Kaori Senryaku Kenkyusho Co., Ltd. provides promotional support by analyzing food taste and turning it into data. Net sales for the fiscal year ended July 2026 were ¥16,030 million.
